stem: Which school-level factor most increases the risk that cyberbullying will be poorly managed?

options.text: No clear school policy or reporting process for cyberbullying
Clear pathways for students to report concerns
Parent and student education about online safety

explanation: A lack of clear school policy and reporting pathways makes cyberbullying harder to prevent, identify and respond to effectively. Whole-school approaches and clear reporting are protective.
